messages:
evan (AE): MonarchBank wants a 2-week POC. Requirements: Okta SAML (signed), SCIM (delta + bulk) for ~500k users, strict RBAC (group->role + attribute rules), per-tenant domain binding via DNS TXT, and automated cert issuance for tenant subdomains. Also procurement wants a short hosted vs dedicated blurb. Any immediate blockers?

sophia (SE): We support SAML2.0 signed assertions; metadata upload OK. Can map attributes -> subject_id + roles claim. SP & IdP initiated flows supported.

sophia (SE): SCIM: RFC7644, PATCH supported, ETag via If-Match. Default rate limit 15 req/s per tenant; Dedicated can be tuned for high-volume (500k user seed should use Bulk endpoint + paged imports).

claire (Solutions): RBAC: map SCIM groups (externalId) to Redwood roles. Attribute-based grants supported (e.g., department=fraud -> role:fraud-analyst). We'll prepare a sample mapping file.

omar (Security): Security asks: CMK support? audit log retention? evidence of deletion? TLS min?

sophia (SE): CMK supported on Dedicated/Private (AWS KMS, Azure Key Vault). Audit logs: default 90 days, extendable. Deletion model: soft-delete 30 days by default; hard-delete via admin API with audit record and deletion certificate. TLS 1.2+ required; TLS1.3 recommended.

evans (AE): (typo) evan: oops. Noted. Monarch wants automatic certs for customer subdomains (tenant.monarch.example). How to handle?

sophia (SE): For delegated subdomains we can provision certs via ACME (Lets Encrypt) when DNS is pointed; for Dedicated we can also support customer-managed ACME or bring-your-own certs. We store cert keys encrypted and rotate per policy.

evans (AE): Procurement blurb please (2 sentences).

claire (Solutions): Draft: "Hosted eval: fastest to validate identity flows with logical tenant isolation and metered pricing; limited CMK options and no SLA during eval. Dedicated: isolated compute/networking with VPC, full CMK support, configurable rate limits and audit retention, SLA-backed availability; pricing on committed capacity (typical entry ~$25k+/mo depending on throughput)."

omar (Security): Add: SOC2 AOC available under NDA and we can provide dataflow sketch showing where PII touches.

evans (AE): Monarch legal asked for a SCIM PATCH + If-Match example and a hard-delete curl sample for compliance.

sophia (SE): PATCH example:

```bash
curl -X PATCH "https://api.redwood.ai/scim/v2/Users/77b2" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $SCIM_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "If-Match: \"etag77\"" \
  -d '{"schemas":["urn:ietf:params:scim:api:messages:2.0:PatchOp"],"Operations":[{"op":"replace","path":"name.givenName","value":"Aisha"}]}'
```

Hard-delete example:

```bash
curl -X DELETE "https://api.redwood.ai/scim/v2/Users/77b2" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $SCIM_TOKEN" \
  -H "If-Match: \"etag77\"" \
  -H "X-Hard-Delete: true" \
  -H "X-Deletion-Justification: \"Regulatory purge MB-2026\""
```

ci-bot: Provisioned POC tenant 'monarch-poc-06' in us-west-2. Temp SCIM token and SAML endpoint sent to evan via DM.

evans (AE): Received. Omar I'll DM the security questionnaire and Monarch legal contact. Kickoff Thurs 10am PT. Claire please attach the mapping sample and procurement blurb in the invite.

claire (Solutions): Will do. I'll also include a short text dataflow for legal: "IdP (Okta) -> SAML -> Redwood Auth -> SCIM provisioning calls -> Runtime (ephemeral caches) -> Audit logs (encrypted KMS). PII: email, name, employee_id in SCIM payloads and audit logs (redacted in exports by default)."

omar (Security): I'll prepare the questionnaire answers and note the AOC request workflow.

evans (AE): Thanks team. I'll update thread post-kickoff if any blockers.
